notes.text: Office of the Chairman announced (2000-05-05) that Cliff Baxter moves from Enron North America to Enron Corp. as Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer, effective immediately.
Office of the Chairman announced that Mark Frevert becomes Chairman and CEO of Enron North America, replacing Cliff Baxter, while remaining Chairman of Enron Europe.
Office of the Chairman announced that John Sherriff becomes President and CEO of Enron Europe.

Office of the Chairman said the changes reflect Enron Net Works' opportunity to expand Enron's business model to other commodity markets and greater coordination needs between North American and European operations driven by EnronOnline.
